purpose: Stop unbounded mechanism accumulation and re-evaluate surviving reality routes after Connection Pressure Scans 007-025. A candidate survives only if public/direct evidence leaves a named or tightly bounded residual after mature routes, permissions, reversibility, acceptance, time, spatial radius, baseload and compatibility costs are considered.

surviving_candidates.resource_side: workers/candidates with potentially real task capability that CVs, certificates and interviews may not fully represent
surviving_candidates.cost_side: employers that may still pay trial-work, supervision, retraining, delayed independent productivity or hiring-error cost after ordinary screening
natural_connection_pressure: Current Xuzhou manufacturing recruitment repeatedly specifies concrete task capabilities such as drawing reading, measuring tools, weld methods and independent test execution rather than relying on credentials alone.
Jiangsu Guorun Machinery publicly recruits a bending trainee under a training agreement and directional cultivation while its welder role specifies detailed observable weld quality requirements.
Xuzhou XCMG Schwing technical-test roles require ability to independently prepare, execute and evaluate functional/performance testing.
Two direct employer probes have already been sent to test whether material residual verification/training cost remains after current screening routes.
surviving_candidates.mature_route_check: Generic skill certification, enterprise evaluation, internships, probation and training already exist. The only potentially valuable residual is cost that remains AFTER those mechanisms.
surviving_candidates.lowest_cost_truth: Wait for one qualified employer response describing the last real case, current workaround and measurable residual cost. Do not build a test/credential product before that.
surviving_candidates.kill_condition: Named employers consistently report that existing practical tests/probation/training already solve the uncertainty at acceptable cost, or no repeated material post-screening loss can be identified.

surviving_candidates.resource_side: target-market local context held by local consumers, distributors, operators, foreign staff, service nodes or other in-market actors
surviving_candidates.cost_side: smaller exporters facing irreversible inventory/logistics/warehouse/market-entry decisions where country-specific mistakes are expensive
natural_connection_pressure: Suining/ShaJi furniture firms publicly describe cross-border entry as requiring large upfront investment, 4-6 month cash cycles, country-specific selection and scarce language/operations talent.
A broader SME globalization survey reports that local operating information is important while many services are shallow and truly deep research can be expensive.
Real workarounds already exist: borrow-the-boat cooperation with mature exporters, joint ventures, marketplace testing, local platforms and public overseas service networks.
surviving_candidates.mature_route_check: Translation, logistics, certification, overseas warehouses, platform operations, surveys, consultants and overseas service points already exist. The remaining edge can only be a specific small decision fact that is too granular for full consulting and cannot be answered more cheaply by a reversible test order.
surviving_candidates.lowest_cost_truth: One direct smaller-exporter account of a recent country-specific decision, current workaround, decision consequence and what information remained unavailable.
surviving_candidates.kill_condition: Cheap test orders, distributors, standard research, platform data or existing overseas service nodes already answer the relevant decisions at acceptable cost.

surviving_candidates.resource_side: new material, process, algorithm, device or capability that demonstrably exists before a high-value downstream use is fully known
surviving_candidates.cost_side: downstream industries already paying for performance properties that the resource may satisfy
natural_connection_pressure: Xuzhou/Jiangsu scene systems explicitly exist because technologies/products can be real before sufficient application validation exists.
Jiangsu's 2026 scene policy creates early-validation, pilot and real-environment application routes for frontier technologies.
The 2026 Jiangsu New Materials Catalogue requires application-field/scene information and is intended to push products toward major projects and application units.
surviving_candidates.mature_route_check: Generic technology-to-scene matching is already heavily institutionalized through scene lists, technology managers, pilot platforms, catalogues and expert systems.
surviving_candidates.lowest_cost_truth: Only pursue a concrete material/capability when a specific downstream paid pain can be matched to measured properties and a bounded sample/test is possible.
surviving_candidates.why_not_p0: Technical interpretation, buyer qualification and validation cycles are usually too long/high-permission for the first external-value-flow mission.

surviving_candidates.resource_side: existing inspections, certificates, filings or technical evidence
surviving_candidates.cost_side: actors blocked because the receiving authority/system cannot accept the evidence in its required scope/state/interface
natural_connection_pressure: Earlier scans captured electricity reconnection, imported pressure-vessel registration and outbound-investment state-consistency cases where evidence existed but the receiving decision owner still could not act.
surviving_candidates.mature_route_check: The missing edge is frequently authoritative acceptance, regulatory interpretation or cross-system state repair rather than missing expertise.
surviving_candidates.lowest_cost_truth: Only investigate when a bounded case has an identifiable acceptance owner and lawful non-authoritative repair path.
surviving_candidates.why_not_p0: High authority dependence, liability and case specificity make it unsuitable for first low-permission external value flow.

surviving_candidates.resource_side: small technical founders/OPCs with usable capability
surviving_candidates.cost_side: enterprises with real tasks but unwilling to spend attention/trust on unknown providers
natural_connection_pressure: Public Xuzhou examples show technically capable founders can fail even to secure free trials until an incubator/park provides legitimate access, problem framing and credibility.
surviving_candidates.mature_route_check: Incubators, parks, scene systems, technology managers and enterprise-service systems already act as trust/access orchestrators.
surviving_candidates.next_truth: Only reopen if a named task repeatedly remains blocked after these orchestrators are used.
surviving_candidates.decision: Do not continue broad 007 mentor/senior-judgment outreach.

surviving_candidates.cost_side: buyers that still incur audit, sample, trial-order, PPAP/OTS, supervision or quality-failure cost after ordinary supplier qualification
natural_connection_pressure: Supplier directories and claims are insufficient; mature buyers use multi-dimensional proof, process/quality evidence and acceptance gates.
Existing systems are already sophisticated, so the residual must be measured AFTER current verification.
surviving_candidates.lowest_cost_truth: Find one named buyer-side recent supplier onboarding/failure case where existing qualification still produced measurable avoidable loss.
surviving_candidates.decision: Do not promote without named buyer cost.

closed_or_reference_only.reason: Xuzhou technology-manager mechanisms already translate vague enterprise pain into technical requirement lists and match expert/result libraries; one public case matched an expert team in under a week.

Xuzhou and Jiangsu are actively operating opportunity/capability lists, application-scene opening, validation and demonstration systems. Residual must be failure AFTER those routes, not absence of a platform.
Laboratory, welding, digital security, commuting, drones, manufacturing and other shared nodes already form when baseload, compatibility, permission and economics fit.
General industrial waste utilization is already high and difficult residuals depend on characterization, regulation, minimum batch, infrastructure and acceptance rather than simple buyer discovery.
Xuzhou/Jiangsu already organize platforms, logistics, certification, overseas warehouses, local service providers and overseas service points. Only a granular residual decision fact could survive.

Xuzhou is building a large city-level SME digital transformation program with approved providers, small-fast-light-precise products, diagnosis, acceptance and chain/cluster deployment. A candidate must show a post-route residual.

portfolio_rule_after_consolidation: Do not add a new active candidate because a mechanism is intellectually interesting.
Prefer actor-level residuals after mature routes over generic gaps.
Public evidence can select the last uncertainty but cannot promote to real task/commitment.
For P0, prefer low-permission, reversible, acceptance-defined tests that can produce direct external truth within days.
If a candidate cannot name the current workaround/cost AND a callable counterparty/resource, keep it as a sensor/watch item.
next_actions: Keep RCL-001 as the active direct-truth route while waiting for either employer reply or an explicit rejection/no-residual signal.
Do not increase employer outreach count merely to manufacture a sample.
Keep RCL-002 as the secondary route; only reopen field action with one specific smaller exporter decision event.
Continue resource-first application discovery only as high-value research until a low-cost bounded sample/test appears.
Search for named post-verification supplier failures and mature-route residuals, not more generic mechanisms.
